messages.content: In one concise sentence, what is the primary architectural benefit of using external declarative JSON rulesets instead of hardcoding Python parsing logic for new LLM providers?

response_timeline.chunk: It decouples provider-specific parsing from core code, enabling new LLM providers to be supported by updating external JSON rules without modifying or redeploying Python logic.
